rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Team Manager is an MCP server that provides a MongoDB-backed control plane for multi-agent orchestration. It converts tasks into governed specialist rooms, allocates token budgets, manages shared context, and maintains audit trails. The server provides 17+ tools covering team onboarding, room planning and dispatch, source registration, shared blackboard, scoped memory, agent checkpointing, and auditable result emission, with approval workflow support and Bright Data source integration.
